items.title: Alabama Shakes – “Garden”
items.summary: "If you don't water your garden, I will/ If you don't show her you love her, I will/ She means more so much more to me than to you/ All of your hard work I'll surely do." So goes "Garden," our latest preview from Alabama Shakes' comeback album I Must Be Dreaming. It's a soft and sultry Southern soul track that feels way to real and raw to qualify as pastiche.
